{DEVICE_TYPE,select, PHONE{I-imeyili yakho, oxhumana nabo, imicimbi yekhalenda, nokuningi kuzovunyelaniswa kule foni. Futhi usulungele ukuqala ukulanda izinhlelo zokusebenza, umculo, namageyimu kusukela ku-Google Play.

{DEVICE_TYPE,select, PHONE{Qala kabusha ifoni yakho uphinde uzame futhi, noma xhumeka ku-Wi-Fi ukuze usethe. Uma usese nenkinga yokwenza kusebenze idatha yeselula, xhumana nenkampani yakho yenethiwekhi.}TABLET{Qala kabusha ithebulethi yakho uphinde uzame futhi, noma xhumeka ku-Wi-Fi ukuze usethe. Uma usese nenkinga yokwenza kusebenze idatha yeselula, xhumana nenkampani yakho yenethiwekhi.}other{Qala kabusha idivayisi yakho uphinde uzame futhi, noma xhumeka ku-Wi-Fi ukuze usethe. Uma usese nenkinga yokwenza kusebenze idatha yeselula, xhumana nenkampani yakho yenethiwekhi.}}
Udinga ukuxhumeka ukuze uqedele izinyathelo ezimbalwa zokugcina zokusetha.\n\n Uma kuvulwe imodi yendiza, i-Wi-Fi, amanethiwekhi eselula, ne-Bluetooth kunqanyuliwe.
Ukuze uthole ama-app nokuningi, xhumeka kunethiwekhi ye-Wi-Fi noma sebenzisa idatha yeselula
Ukuze usethe i-eSIM yakho, xhuma ku-Wi-Fi
Kudingeka uxhunywe kuyi-Wi-Fi noma kunethiwekhi yeselula ukuze ukopishe idatha yakho.\n\n Ungasebenzisa inethiwekhi yeselula yakho Kumasethingi.
Ukuze uqedele ukusebenzisa i-%1$s, uzodinga ukulanda uhlelo lokusebenza le-%2$s. Okwamanje, masiqedele ukusetha ifoni yakho.
Ukuze uqedele inombolo yakho, uzodinga ukulanda uhlelo lokusebenza le-%1$s. Okwamanje, masiqedele ukusetha ifoni yakho.
